brief: Answers what machine and operating system the program runs on, with a predicate for each family and width.
detail: It reads the processor facts (architecture, pointer width, byte order) from the engine and the operating-system family from Ring, and offers one TRUE or FALSE question per family and per width, so a program branches on the machine instead of parsing a name. Name gives the family as a lower-case word, Info gathers the facts in a list of pairs, and PathSeparator, LineEnding, NormalizePath and ExecutableExtension answer what a path or a program file looks like here. It only reads: nothing is changed on the machine.
